scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.db:init: docker compose exec mongo mongosh --quiet --eval "try { rs.status().ok } catch (e) { rs.initiate({ _id: 'rs0', members: [{ _id: 0, host: 'localhost:27017' }] }).ok }"
